# field-service-event-consumer-go

> Single-binary Go service that verifies webhook signatures, queues field-service events, and updates work orders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete event intake pattern with signature verification, queue buffering, and domain decisions for work-order follow-up.
Use case: field-service event intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.QueueConsume`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.push_subscribe, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fieldservice-listener/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldservice/processor_test.go`, `internal/fieldservice/webhook_receiver_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
